_comment: Example browser-voice workflow using OpenAI's Realtime API as the Voice Agent cluster
element.
Same shape as docs/examples/voice/deepgram-voiceagent.json: the browser/v1/voiceSession
trigger is a cluster root with 'voiceAgent' (required, exactly one) and 'tools' (optional,
omitted here) as sibling slots under 'clusterElements'. No workflow job runs while the call
is live -- 'openAi/v1/voiceAgent' bridges audio to wss://api.openai.com/v1/realtime and does
speech-to-text, LLM reasoning and text-to-speech itself. Once the caller hangs up, this
workflow's 'tasks' run once as a continuation job with the session summary as the trigger's
output.
To use:
1. Create an OpenAI API key with Realtime API access (https://platform.openai.com).
2. Create an OpenAI connection in ByteChef with the key.
3. Import this JSON as a new workflow.
4. Replace 'YOUR_OPENAI_CONNECTION_ID' below with your actual connection id.
5. Publish the workflow to get its webhook URL, or open it in the editor and use the
test panel's voice layout directly (draft definitions are testable without publishing).
Customize:
* model: gpt-realtime (default), gpt-realtime-mini, gpt-4o-realtime-preview, or
gpt-4o-mini-realtime-preview.
* voice: the OpenAI Realtime voice to speak with (default alloy).
* instructions: defines the agent's behavior and persona.
* greeting: the assistant's opening line when the call starts, delivered as a first
response.create instructing the model to say it verbatim.
* inputAudioTranscription: leave true to get a user transcript (conversation.item.
input_audio_transcription.completed); OpenAI never transcribes caller audio without it.
* Add a 'tools' array beside 'voiceAgent' in clusterElements to let the agent call
ByteChef actions mid-call -- see docs/voice/quickstart.md, Step 3. A tool that requires
approval will refuse to run during a voice call; there is no job to suspend for it.
Audio format notes:
* inputSampleRate (16000 here) MUST match the trigger's sampleRate -- inbound browser
audio at that rate is resampled internally to the 24 kHz OpenAI's Realtime API requires.
Setting the trigger to 24000 avoids the resample step entirely.
* outputSampleRate is informational only: OpenAI's Realtime API always emits 24 kHz PCM16
regardless of this value; it exists so the browser's playback buffer can be told the
real rate up front.
label: Voice Assistant (OpenAI Realtime)
description: Browser voice session with an OpenAI Realtime Voice Agent -- handles STT, LLM, and TTS over the Realtime API WebSocket.

parameters.instructions: You are a helpful voice assistant for ByteChef. Keep responses concise and natural for spoken delivery -- avoid markdown, bullet lists, or long paragraphs. When the user asks you to do something you can't do, say so directly rather than improvising.
parameters.greeting: Hi there! How can I help?
